Aphc010060662020
 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh

AT AMARAVATI [3458]
 (Special Original Jurisdiction)
 WEDNESDAY ,THE SIXTH DAY OF NOVEMBER  TWO THOUSAND AND TWENTY FOUR  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE SMT JUSTICE KIRANMAYEE MANDAVA  WRIT PETITION NO: 3716/2020 Between:
Sattineedi Sattibabu, and Others ...PETITIONER(S)
 AND The State Of Andhra Pradesh and Others ...RESPONDENT(S)
Counsel for the Petitioner(S):
 1. K SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Counsel for the Respondent(S):
 1. GP FOR REVENUE (AP)

The Court made the following:
ORDER:
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue.

2. The writ petition is filed assailing the action of the respondents in trying to evict the petitioners from their property in an extent of Ac.0.12 cents in Rs.No.307/5 situated in Gumparru Village,
Yelamanchilli Mandal, West Godavari District, without resorting to Land Acquisition Proceedings under the provisions Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (in short "The Act").
3.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The contention of the petitioners is that they purchased the subject land from one Mr. Bokka Ramakrishnaiah and they have been in possession of the property and they have constructed house by duly obtaining permission from the respondent authorities.

On 09.02.2020, the respondents Sattineedi Sattibabu, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78929338/
1 have attempted to evict the petitioner without following the due procedure under the Act.

sentences.text: 4. The respondents have filed counter, wherein it is stated by the 4 th respondent - Tahsildar that the proposals were submitted to the District Collector vide Proceedings, dated 30.01.2020, after identifying the subject property for allotment of the house site, under the scheme floated by the Government of Andhra Pradesh viz., "Navaratanalu - Pedalandariki Illu".

However, the Proposals have been dropped and alternative lands were identified in Rs.No.307-5 of Gumparru Village,
Elamanchili Mandal, for issuance of the house site pattas to the eligible beneficiaries.
5. In view of the said submissions made by the respondent No.4, the grievance of the petitioner in the writ petition does not merit consideration.
In view of the same, no further orders are required to be passed in the writ petition.
Recording the said submission, the writ petition is disposed of.
6. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, all pending miscellaneous applications shall stand closed.

_______________________________ JUSTICE KIRANMAYEE MANDAVA Date:
